## About
Sagar Pansuriya is a Technical Lead and Frontend Architect with over 10 years of experience scaling frontend teams and shipping 100+ web applications. He specializes in architecting scalable digital ecosystems and high-performance systems:
- **Core Offerings:** Architecture Strategy & Audits, Enterprise-Grade Builds, Desktop Strategy (NativePHP), and Performance Engineering.
- **Frontend:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Alpine.js, GSAP, Modern CSS
- **Backend/Full-stack:** Laravel (TALL Stack), WordPress (Roots/Sage/Bedrock DNA), NativePHP
- **Architecture:** Frontend Architecture, Production-Scale Systems, Open Source Contribution, Technical Leadership

## Technical Content & AI Features
Sagar maintains a technical blog focusing on the intersection of Laravel, WordPress, and Frontend Architecture. All blog posts include "Explore with AI" interactive components for instant summarization.

### Core Topics
- **Laravel & WordPress:** Building enterprise-grade WordPress using the Roots ecosystem (Sage, Bedrock, Acorn).
- **NativePHP:** Research and fixes for bringing PHP to Desktop and Mobile (Android/iOS), including deep comparisons with NativeBlade (PHP-WASM + Tauri 2).
- **Frontend Performance:** Optimizing Core Web Vitals and replacing JavaScript with Modern CSS.
- **AI Strategy:** Implementing "Markdown for AI" site-wide to improve agent indexing.
